fato_historico: 1184: Erfurt latrine disaster: At a Hoftag, a meeting with local notables, organized by Henry VI, the building collapses and many of the nobles in attendance drown in the sewage pits below.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to find stability amidst chaos today, Sagittarius. Just as history reminds us that even grand gatherings can face unexpected shifts, your spirit may feel called to ground itself deeply. It is a good time to release heavy burdens and rise above transient misfortunes, focusing instead on the vast horizon of your potential.
frase_do_dia: True strength rises from the depths to touch the golden sky above.
significado_numero: Represents the pursuit of harmony through challenging transitions and personal growth.
conselho: Stay mindful of your surroundings and prioritize your peace of mind today.
